title: A legal team's internal case law
description: The rulings by which a legal team settles how its playbook applies where the playbook alone can be read two ways. Every AI tool and every reviewer the team uses follows the rulings in force.

playbook.description: The playbook the rulings interpret (path or name).

date.description: The day the ruling takes effect.

question.description: The question of interpretation, as a reviewer would ask it.

holding.description: The answer, written to apply to every document it covers, with its limit.

positions.description: The playbook positions it interprets: a change to one of them flags the ruling for review.

law.description: Legal facts the ruling rests on: a change in one of them flags the ruling for review.

examples.description: The documents or edge cases it was decided on.

raised_by.description: How the question arose: a disagreement between reviewers, an edge review, a person.

confirmed.description: Readings the team checked and kept, recorded so that a later model's drift from them shows.
